title: Status of Sulphur Dioxide in B.C.
summary: Explore 2022–2024 sulphur dioxide (SO₂) management levels across B.C.'s seven air zones and 38 monitoring-station map locations.
sourceNote: This project preserves the station locations, management levels, and click details embedded in Environmental Reporting BC's June 2026 SO₂ map. It reuses the shared seven-zone CAAQS boundary. The Province's so2-caaqs-indicator repository documents the R workflow used to load, clean, analyse, quality-check, and publish the source results.
details: SO₂ has annual and one-hour Canadian Ambient Air Quality Standards; management uses the more stringent resulting level.
The map contains 38 station locations, while data sufficiency differs by metric: 37 annual and 36 one-hour station assessments were reported.
Click or tap any air zone or station for the Province's detailed 2022–2024 result.
